comment: task-87: FUN_00462020 (golfer portrait page) indexes the 0x58-byte object table at 0x81ca6c with stack slots Ghidra mis-tracked (stack addresses, return addresses). The original never read them as indexes; the browser build read zero pages. gs_slot() (ghidra_prelude.h) returns the slot for a plausible index and null otherwise, so the garbage reads are skipped natively however the stack happens to sit (a stack address times 0x58 can land above 2 GB where host_win32.c cannot commit a zero page).
